description: Allowlist for npm audit vulnerabilities accepted by the LedgerFlow team (S-25)

notes.how-to-use: Add vulnerability identifiers to the 'allow' array to suppress false positives
best-practices: Only allowlist vulnerabilities that are false positives or accepted risks
Document the reason for each allowlist entry in a comment
Review the allowlist regularly (at least quarterly)
Each entry should include: package name, severity, reason, and expiration date
